blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats with a captain to cruise Lake Murray, swim, sunbathe, and dock at lakeside restaurants. Popular tours include the Purple Martin Tour from June to September to watch bird roosting at dusk. Boats are 24-28 feet long and equipped with life jackets, anchors, a map, radio, swimming ladder, and cooler; fishing pontoons include fishing chairs, rod holders, and a fish/depth finder.
